title: When the Orbit Burns
author: Ada Almeida
blurb: Tamsin Amberdale, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
